paper_title: A Coin Has Two Sides A Novel Detector-Corrector Framework for Chinese   Spelling Correction
caption: Proportion of correct corrections among various error detection results in SIGHAN15. "P" signifies the errors in high precision results, "R" signifies in high recall results, "N" signifies not been detected. The suffix "W" indicates cases where correction has failed.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the proportion of correct corrections achieved across various error detection results, specifically within the context of Chinese spelling correction. The chart contains seven distinct slices, all colored differently: “P” is green, “PW” is light blue, “R” is red, “RW” is dark blue, “N” is blue, and “NW” is dark purple. The largest slice, colored green, represents 56%, followed by the slice labeled “P,” which is approximately 29% and colored green. The slice labeled "R" is red and accounts for approximately 14%, while the slice labeled "N" is blue and represents 6%. The slice labelled “PW” is colored light blue and shows 4%, and the slice labelled "NW" is dark purple and represents 3%. The slice labeled “RW” is dark blue and accounts for 5%. Percentages are displayed within each slice. There is no legend present in the chart.
